scope: simple pen/tool visual sanity check only; no AUBO i5 robot model, no IK, no dynamics simulation, and no real robot control

paper_frame.name: paper_frame
paper_frame.origin: center of the square paper plane at Z=0

axes.X: positive CSV/workspace X on the paper plane
axes.Y: positive CSV/workspace Y on the paper plane

paper_frame.unit: mm in CSV, converted to m in CoppeliaSim

workspace_frame.name: workspace_frame
workspace_frame.relationship_to_paper_frame: coincident with paper_frame in the current standard scene, plus optional base_frame_origin_mm offset metadata

tool_tcp_frame.name: tool_tcp_frame
tool_tcp_frame.origin: trajectory point is treated as the writing TCP / pen tip
tool_tcp_frame.tool_axis: simple-pen body is visualized along +Z from the pen tip
tool_tcp_frame.orientation_convention: robot_target_poses currently uses fixed roll=180deg, pitch=0deg, yaw=0deg for a vertical-down writing pose

axes.X: positive CSV/workspace X on the paper plane
axes.Y: positive CSV/workspace Y on the paper plane

tcp_convention.csv_xyz: X_mm/Y_mm/Z_mm are the pen-tip TCP target in the paper/workspace frame
tcp_convention.tool_body: simple-pen cylinder is only a visual orientation aid and is not a collision or dynamics object
